methodology: Original source photograph pixels, automatic crops frozen before fitting. No reference template geometry enters the fitter. Every accepted candidate is measured against the unchanged classified photo mask and independently rendered from its export. The central 60% square isolates branch detail; it is not digitized artwork ground truth.
